title: Café props: bentwood chair, table, pendant, sconce, booth, espresso machine
summary: Night-café furniture and practicals at real size: Thonet-style bentwood chair, café table, pendant with haze cone and lights, lantern sconce, cup and saucer, duffel, banquette booth, espresso machine.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { bentwoodChair, cafeTable, pendant, sconce, booth, espressoMachine } from '../library/module.recon.cafe-props/index.js';

doc.when: Cafés, bars, restaurants, diners, waiting rooms at night or in the day (lights are part of pendant/sconce: pass smaller cone/i for daylight).
doc.avoid: Using pendant/sconce lights as the only light of a big room: they are practicals; add a key/fill.
gotchas: pendant() needs o.ceil (the ceiling height) to draw its cord; its lights are added to S.scene in world space via the parent's matrix.

booth(): figures go INSIDE the booth group (parent: B) so they turn and scale with it; seat them with sitOn(S, f, { at: B.localToWorld(V(+-.88, seatY, 0)).toArray(), face: table point }) from lib/props.js (it measures the posed body), then act() WITHOUT seat:. o.seat .41 keeps seated knees under the .775 table top.
Chairs get a small deterministic yaw jitter from their position (o.jitter false to disable).
Table tops and booth cushions/backs are returned as solids for S.collide.

params.pendant o: ceil r mat rim inner ie color i cone angle beam beamTo beamColor shadow
params.booth o: rot pos scale tableRot props seat (cushion top, default .52)
